title: Plate Filling Heat Inactivated Covid Samples for PCR - Part 2
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the number of samples (choose an integer between 1 and 94); samples will be picked by row from the tube racks in the order of slots 7, 8, 10, and 11; specify which side to mount the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Transfer 6 µL sample
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette mounted as specified, aspirate 6 µL from column 1 of the source deep‑well plate and dispense into the corresponding well(s) of the destination deep‑well plate for each sample.
